title: All Hell Breaks Loose When Drunk Mom Falls Asleep In A Drive -Thru
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On April 7th, 2023. Officers received a 911 call regarding a highly intoxicated woman who fell asleep in a Taco Bell drive-through with her kids in the backseat. The employee who call stated that, she noticed she could barely talk & was falling asleep mid-conversation, she also said that when she tried to back up, she almost hit the vehicle behind her. After conducting the field sobriety test on the woman, officers placed her under arrest and all hell started to break loose with her, she started yelling and saying she had nothing to drink, she refused to enter the squad car. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
